method: Actual local candidate browser screenshots, desktop and mobile; original images individually inspected during acquisition

reviews.result: Prayer hall remains identifiable behind readable text; mobile crop intentionally selects the central hall rather than implying the whole courtyard is visible.
Adjusted horizontal focal position from50 to75, retained top anchor0; mobile screenshot verifies the right minaret and finial are no longer cut off by the right edge.
Dominant portrait keeps the brick arcade and tiled doorway legible.
Intentional narrower supporting crop retains the fountain basin; not captioned as Lahore Fort.
Portal and finials retained; text and photo do not overlap.
Layered ruins remain legible in the supporting landscape crop.
Gateway crown and main arch retained in card and detail treatments.
Documentary archaeological image verified in selected-place interface; not used as a promotional hero.

limits: This is representative page-crop QA, not a claim that every possible viewport or placement was manually viewed. Monochrome Badshahi and Baltit originals were individually reviewed; no homepage hero use is recommended for them. Other responsive variants are covered by source metadata and local asset/link checks.
